## Summary
- Durable `collection_resolutions` + idempotency ledger (expand migration `004`)
- `POST /v1/collection-resolutions` create / confirm / refresh with service-token auth
- Sonar `resolve-probe` HTTP client + catalog fallback for local/dev
- Protocol package `@freeside/collection-resolution-protocol` + Ordering service/store (CAS, 15m TTL, digests)

## Test plan
- [x] `vitest` resolution-service + resolution-store + resolution-http
- [ ] Railway deploy with `RUN_MIGRATIONS=true`, `SONAR_RESOLVE_PROBE_URL`, `SERVICE_TOKEN`
- [ ] Curl create for Azuki/BAYC → 200 (not 404); distinct candidate names
